description: FIVHIC crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C81 H54 Er3 N9 O9,C2 H3 N1. From the CIF bond table, Er1 (Er) has 4 O neighbors; Er2 (Er) has 7 O neighbors; Er3 (Er) has 4 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.488-3.495 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 93.57-97.81°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula Er3Q9·CH3CN (Q = 8-quinolinolate; C81H54Er3N9O9·C2H3N). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
